title: feat: LTB-local stored evidence resolver
intent: Persist an LTB-local evidence record and resolve PhysicalEngineeringProposalV1 citations by exact id. Storage and resolution grant no engineering or manufacturing authority.
behavior_change: A caller-supplied directory can now store immutable evidence JSON and a StoredEvidenceResolver can return one ResolvedEvidence or a typed failure. No route, policy, UI, or manufacturing authority is added.

diff_articulation.what_changed: New LTB-local evidence record, canonical SHA-256, exclusive JSON file repository, and StoredEvidenceResolver. The beginner harness and proposal gate are unchanged. Sprint notes record the PR #454 stop and keep validation policy separate.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The proposal gate could only resolve the in-memory test fixture. A durable exact-id resolver is required before a review route can cite evidence, and this patch does not invent a Mesh schema or a validation policy.

commands_run: services/api on a0861507 before this patch: pytest test_beginner_proposal_harness.py test_physical_engineering_proposal_v1.py test_pep_v1_harden_001.py -q --no-cov: 102 passed
services/api: focused evidence plus those three files -q --no-cov: 142 passed
services/api: python -m compileall -q app/physical_engineering: OK. Full app compileall still fails on five pre-existing files this diff does not touch.
